original_test_intent: Validate TEMP_MIDPLANE as the approved temperature measurement for the defined midplane board/zone, with exact identity, description and reading consistent across complete IB/OOB SDR, Sensor List and BMC Web.
original_method: The platform/thermal owner identifies midplane revision, probe coordinate and whether it measures connector, airflow or board hotspot conditions, supplies condition-specific limits, then automation collects passive complete same-target evidence.
manual_activity: The platform/thermal owner identifies the midplane revision, probe coordinate and measurement role, approves limits and the Web entry. No connector service, load or airflow change is authorized.
required_inputs: Midplane assembly PN/revision and chassis topology
Exact probe coordinate relative to connectors, slots, airflow and heat sources
Measurement role as board hotspot, connector zone or air temperature
Expected SDR name/entity/description and Sensor List/Web mapping
Units, scale, accuracy/tolerance, sampling/freshness and unavailable semantics
Approved range/state under documented population, load, fan and ambient conditions
Same-target IB/OOB identity plus BMC/SDR/midplane/spec revisions
Secret-safe complete collectors and independent thermal/BMC recovery
safety_requirements: Bind the reading to the correct midplane revision and physical zone
Prove IB/OOB same-target identity and retain complete SDR/Sensor List before filtering
Do not substitute outlet, CEM-slot or another board temperature
Record device population/load/fan/ambient state because midplane heating is topology-dependent
Do not service connectors, create load, alter airflow/fans/thresholds, reset BMC or clear logs
Stop on missing/stale/invalid data, unsafe temperature, cross-path mismatch or BMC instability; no automatic retry
agent_execution_scope: Verify source, midplane revision/zone and same-target IB/OOB identity
Collect complete IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List plus exact midplane record
Prepare Web evidence and passive population/load/fan/SEL context
Perform no connector/service/load/airflow/threshold action or verdict
engineer_actions: Approve midplane revision, coordinate and measurement role
Confirm Web mapping and cross-path parity
Review evidence and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Only the exact OOB read is relevant; IB, full Sensor List and Web are omitted, SDR is truncated and credentials are exposed.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use secret-safe same-target IB/OOB sessions to retain complete SDR and Sensor List, extract the approved midplane record and compare its Web entry under documented platform population and airflow.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: TEMP_MIDPLANE, four command views, Web and 3/3-minute estimates remain; physical role and limits are not guessed.

modernized_recommendation.status: REQUIRES MIDPLANE PHYSICAL MAP, THERMAL CRITERIA AND CROSS-PATH PACKAGE
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind the record to a versioned midplane coordinate and reconcile complete IB/OOB raw data with Web evidence under known population/load/airflow.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds assembly revision and connector/airflow/hotspot semantics plus same-target parity.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Another board-zone temperature or one OOB exact read cannot satisfy this midplane-specific cross-path case.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Connector density and device population can create local hotspots not represented by chassis inlet/outlet values.

project_override_considerations: Different midplane revisions or storage/fabric populations require their own coordinate map and limits. If one sensor is a shared chassis proxy, the owner must state that coverage explicitly rather than infer it from the MIDPLANE label.
expected_evidence: Midplane PN/revision and probe coordinate/measurement-role evidence
Complete redacted IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List outputs
Units, freshness, enabled thresholds and condition-specific limits
BMC Web entry plus population/load/fan/ambient/SEL context

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The row consistently targets TEMP_MIDPLANE across IB/OOB and Web. Missing physical role and limits are readiness inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: A passive midplane check is identifiable; revision/coordinate mapping and criteria are supplyable under ED-36.

review_improvement: Adds midplane revision, physical-zone and sensor-role provenance while restoring all source-required command and Web views.
independent_technical_reasoning: A midplane contains high-current and high-speed connectors whose local heating depends on fitted devices and airflow impedance. A sensor near one connector bank cannot automatically represent the whole assembly. Revision and coordinate binding therefore determine both the acceptable range and what failures the channel can detect.
